import itertools

def has_clique(graph, k):
    """Check if graph has a clique of size k"""
    n = len(graph)
    for subset in itertools.combinations(range(n), k):
        if all(graph[i][j] for i, j in itertools.combinations(subset, 2)):
            return True
    return False

def has_independent_set(graph, k):
    """Check if graph has an independent set of size k"""
    n = len(graph)
    for subset in itertools.combinations(range(n), k):
        if all(not graph[i][j] for i, j in itertools.combinations(subset, 2)):
            return True
    return False
